description: Complete scalar local boundary around pinned OpenTitan Earlgrey GPIO TL-UL target. Alert receiver and RACL policy are source-typed defaults; alert, RACL, strap, GPIO, and IRQ outputs are exposed.

resets.release: rst_ni is the single active-low reset of the gpio IP and its generated register block; every state element is written on posedge clk_i with asynchronous assertion (gpio.sv:129-134,149-162 and the prim_subreg/prim_intr_hw/prim_filter_ctr instances), so deassertion must satisfy clk_i recovery/removal timing. cio_gpio_q and cio_gpio_en_q leave reset at 0 for all 32 pads, the interrupt state and the strap registers leave reset cleared.

interrupts.hold: Bit 0 of one bussified prim_intr_hw with Width=NumIOs=32, the default FlopOutput=1 and the default IntrT("Event") (gpio.sv:170-181; prim_intr_hw.sv:39,62-70,96-102): the output is the registered level intr_gpio_o[0] = INTR_STATE[0] & INTR_ENABLE[0] and the state bit is set by the combined event for pad 0, (event_rise & INTR_CTRL_EN_RISING[0]) | (event_fall & INTR_CTRL_EN_FALLING[0]) | (data_in_d[0] & INTR_CTRL_EN_LVLHIGH[0]) | (~data_in_d[0] & INTR_CTRL_EN_LVLLOW[0]) (gpio.sv:183-193), with event_rise/event_fall derived from the filtered pin registered one cycle earlier (gpio.sv:75-80). It stays asserted until software clears the state bit.
interrupts.clear: Write 1 to INTR_STATE[0] (W1C, gpio_reg_top.sv:195-220) or clear INTR_ENABLE[0]; INTR_TEST[0] can force it. The event controls (INTR_CTRL_EN_*) and the per-pad input filter (CTRL_EN_INPUT_FILTER[0]) select which pin transitions produce the event.

interrupts.hold: Same bussified prim_intr_hw as bit 0 (gpio.sv:170-193): intr_gpio_o[1] = INTR_STATE[1] & INTR_ENABLE[1], set by the rise/fall/level event of pad 1 and held until cleared.
interrupts.clear: Write 1 to INTR_STATE[1] (W1C) or clear INTR_ENABLE[1]; INTR_TEST[1] can force it.
